s.note: Pepitas roasted with butter, brown sugar, smoked paprika and cinnamon until crunchy
s.how: Heat the oven to 170C. Toss 200g pepitas with 20g melted butter, 1 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 0.5 tsp ground cinnamon, a pinch of cayenne and 0.5 tsp salt. Spread on a lined tray and roast for 14 minutes, stirring halfway, until puffed and crunchy. Cool on the tray.

s.note: Soft white bread with creamy egg, mayonnaise, mustard and chives, crusts off
s.how: Lower 6 eggs into boiling water and cook for 10 minutes, then cool in iced water. Peel and mash with 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 tsp yellow mustard, 2 tbsp snipped chives, 0.5 tsp salt and a pinch of white pepper. Butter 8 slices of soft white bread with 30g butter, fill, cut off the crusts and cut each sandwich into 3 fingers.

m.note: Chicken, carrot, celery and peas in a creamy thyme sauce under a puff pastry lid
m.how: Brown 800g chicken thigh fillets in 3cm pieces in 20g butter and set aside. Soften 1 diced onion, 2 diced carrots, 2 diced celery sticks and 2 crushed garlic cloves in another 20g butter for 8 minutes. Stir in 40g plain flour for a minute, then gradually add 500ml chicken stock and 125ml thickened cream with 1 tsp thyme leaves and simmer for 10 minutes until thick. Return the chicken with 1 cup frozen peas, season with 1 tsp salt and 0.5 tsp pepper and cool a little. Heat the oven to 200C. Pour into a 2 litre pie dish, lay over 2 thawed sheets of puff pastry, crimp the edges, cut a slit and brush with beaten egg. Bake for 30 minutes until puffed and deep golden, and rest 5 minutes.

w.note: Crisp red apples dipped in glassy cinnamon red toffee
w.how: Wash 6 small red apples in hot water to strip the wax, dry well and push a wooden stick into each. Lightly oil a sheet of baking paper. Heat 400g white sugar, 125ml water, 3 tbsp glucose syrup and 1 cinnamon stick, stirring until the sugar dissolves, then boil without stirring to 150C on a sugar thermometer. Take off the heat, lift out the cinnamon and stir in 0.5 tsp red food colouring. Tilt the pan and dip each apple, twirling to coat, then stand on the paper for 20 minutes to set hard.

d.note: Cloudy apple juice mulled with cinnamon, cloves, star anise, ginger and orange
d.how: Put 1.5 litres cloudy apple juice in a pot with 1 sliced orange, 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 2 star anise, a 3cm piece of sliced ginger and 1 tbsp brown sugar. Bring to just below a simmer, then keep on the lowest heat for 20 minutes without boiling. Strain into 4 mugs and add an orange slice and a cinnamon stick to each.
